description: I’m building EarthTrends, an interactive 3D globe that turns 20 years of NASA satellite data into answers anyone can understand: is the climate really changing where you live? I combine GPM IMERG rainfall, MERRA-2 temperature and cloud cover, and GRACE/GRACE-FO water storage with rigorous trend statistics (Mann-Kendall with false-discovery-rate correction) to separate real, sustained change from natural year-to-year noise.
